WITH employee_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    ReportsTo,
    COUNT(*) as employee_count
  FROM Employee
  GROUP BY ReportsTo
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(employee_count) as total_employees,
    COUNT(*) as num_groups
  FROM employee_counts
)
SELECT 
  ec.ReportsTo,
  ec.employee_count,
  ec.employee_count / t.total_employees as share,
  (ec.employee_count / t.total_employees) - (1.0 / t.num_groups) as difference_from_average
FROM employee_counts ec
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC
LIMIT 10
